Born at Stundwiller on 13 April 1783, son of Antoine Philipps and Marguerite Klehammer.
He married Marie Angélique Schmitt of Oberlauterbach on 25 January 1817, and their daughter Margaretha,
born in 1831, married Frank Staebell in America.
He died at Stundwiller on 12 June 1848.
Born at Oberlauterbach on 15 May 1795, daughter of Pierre Schmitt and Madelaine Werner.
She married Antoine Philipps at Stundwiller in 1817 and died there on 19 March 1859.
Of her daughters, Margaretha went to America, and Caroline stayed and married the other François Staebell of the village.
